title: Trace2Eval: Contextualized Evaluation of Coding Agents from Real-World Traces
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We propose Trace2Eval, a dynamically updatable pipeline that constructs benchmarks from real-world interaction trajectories.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Coding agents are increasingly used in real-world workflows across diverse domains, motivating evaluation grounded in real user tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Guided by feedback from the Trace2Eval pipeline, models revise their initial artifacts, yielding a mean score gain of 10.05 percentage points across 19 model-harness configurations and a maximum of 19.28 percentage points for DeepSeek-V4-Pro with Claude Code, which supports rubric feedback as actionable guidance for artifact improvement.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: To evaluate these artifacts, the pipeline iteratively refines human rubrics through inter-annotator alignment, and calibrates judge agents against human assessments using source-code and runtime evidence.
